app.tagline: Replace damaged pages in a scanned PDF with fresh rescans. Everything stays on this computer.
load.title: Add the files
load.original_hint: The damaged scan. Click or drop one PDF here.
load.rescans_hint: Photos, images or PDFs of the pages to swap in, in any order.
load.ocr: Also read the text (needs an OCR engine)
load.private: Files are processed by a server on your own machine and are not uploaded anywhere.
review.title: Review the matches
review.hint: Check each rescan against its suggested page. Only rescans labelled Clear can be exported without a confirmation.
review.keys: Keys: j and k move between rescans, 1 to 8 pick a candidate page, c confirms and jumps to the next one that needs a check. z opens a closer look.
reason.no_match: no original page shares enough features or text with this rescan
reason.contested: another rescan also ranks page {page} first
reason.blank: blank pages carry no evidence: confirm the position yourself
reason.blank_none: this rescan is blank and the original has no blank page
view.overlay_caption: Ink only in the original is orange, ink only in the rescan is blue
view.features_caption: Lines join features that agree on one placement
view.unavailable: This view is not available for this pair.
view.nothing: No page is selected for this rescan.
export.title: Export
export.summary: {assigned} of {total} rescans are assigned. {untouched} original pages stay untouched.
export.drop: Allow dropping annotations on replaced pages
export.done: Replaced {n} pages. {untouched} pages are the original objects.
demo.banner: Live demo: this page replays a real run of the matcher on the bundled sample. To use your own files, install Darnleaf and run it locally.
demo.nofiles: This replay has no file upload. Install Darnleaf to use your own files.
